incident_this_slice.what: A live AUTO cycle imported a half-written brain.py and crashed with `NameError: name 'is_dispatchable' is not defined` (recorded in learning/control_panel/latest.log).
incident_this_slice.why: The dispatchable predicate landed in the route body while its import was missing: the import edit had been applied and then reverted by the concurrent external writer of brain.py (the documented file-flush hazard), and the reload marker meant to hold AUTO off the tree was never actually written -- the guard script died on an ImportError (`reload_path` lives in control_panel.py, not runtime_reload.py) and the failure was not re-checked before editing.
incident_this_slice.so: the protection silently did not exist; protect-then-verify-the-protection is the lesson, not protect-then-assume
incident_this_slice.impact: one AUTO cycle aborted on the BEAST_HUNT route before any action; no device action, no stamina spent, no evidence lost
incident_this_slice.recovery: import re-applied, tests + check_wiring re-run (the project's documented protocol after an out-of-band flush), and a fresh cycle confirmed clean at 15:44:09Z
